name: stat-trio
title: Stat Trio
description: Three stats count up side by side (stacked in a vertical frame), staggered, each with its label and an accent underline that draws in beneath it. Values like 1.200+, 4,9 or 98% keep their prefix, suffix and decimals while they count.
useWhen: Social proof in three numbers: customers, rating, repeat orders.
A small shop's milestones at a glance.
avoidWhen: One hero number with a chart: use stat-count-up-bars.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Line above the stats. Empty hides it.

variables.label: Stats
variables.description: Three lines, Value|Label. Dots are thousands and a comma is a decimal: 1.200+ or 4,9.
variables.default:
1.200+|Pelanggan setia
4,9|Rating dari 860 ulasan
98%|Pesanan datang tepat waktu

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: The three underlines: the one accent.

variables.label: Font
variables.description: Google Fonts family name; Geist is loaded, others only if the host loads them.

variables.description: Leave the background clear so the block sits over your own scene.
